instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Overview of LessonBridge Absence Trail: It coordinates makeup activities for enrolled students who miss scheduled learning sessions and closes each absence case after all assigned work is accepted. The Attendance Clerk records the missed session. The Teacher lists makeup activities, records a due date, and reviews submissions as accepted or needing revision. The Student marks activities as submitted and may add notes. The Academic Coordinator closes the case only after every activity is accepted. Changing course grades is excluded.

output.summary: LessonBridge Absence Trail coordinates makeup activities for enrolled students who miss scheduled learning sessions and closes each absence case after all assigned work is accepted. The Attendance Clerk records the missed session, the Teacher lists makeup activities, records a due date, and reviews submissions, and the Student records submissions with optional notes. The Academic Coordinator closes the case only after every activity is accepted, while changing course grades is excluded.
output.primary_goal: Coordinate makeup activities for enrolled students who miss scheduled learning sessions and close each absence case after all assigned work is accepted.
key_capabilities: Record a missed scheduled learning session.
List makeup activities and record a due date.
Mark makeup activities as submitted and add submission notes.
Record submissions as accepted or needing revision.
Close an absence case only after every activity is accepted.
